title: Claims Look-Back by Age of a Carried Referral (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment — which paid claims count as already used on a carried specialist referral.**

When a single referral issued under an earlier Primary Care Provider Assignment is carried onto the member's current assignment, the visits already used on it are the member's paid specialist-visit claims billed by the referred specialist — the claims booked on the member's **Medicaid Managed Care Membership** — counted over a look-back window that depends on the age of the carried referral.

### Rule

Which paid claims count as already used depends on the age of the carried referral in whole months from its issue date to the handling date:

- a referral **younger than 3 months** counts only the claims with a service date in the recent window of **3 months**;
- a referral **at least 3 months old but younger than 6 months** counts only the claims in the middle window of **6 months**;
- any older referral — **6 months old or more** — counts the claims in the standard look-back window of **12 months**.

Every look-back window here is a trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a record is inside a window of a given number of months when fewer than that number of whole months separate its date from the handling date, so a record dated exactly that number of months back is outside it.

### Schedule

| Age of the carried referral (whole months since issue) | Claims counted as already used |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | Service date within the last 3 months |
| 3, 4 or 5 | Service date within the last 6 months |
| 6 or more | Service date within the last 12 months |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical referrals, handling date 15 September 2026)

| Issue date | Whole months old | Window applied |
|---|---|---|
| 16 June 2026 | 2 | 3 months |
| 15 June 2026 | 3 | 6 months |
| 16 March 2026 | 5 | 6 months |
| 15 March 2026 | 6 | 12 months |

### Worked example (hypothetical)

A referral issued 20 April 2026 is 4 whole months old on 15 September 2026, so the 6-month window applies. Paid specialist-visit claims by the referred specialist dated 16 March 2026 (5 whole months back, inside) and 2 July 2026 (inside) count; a claim dated 15 March 2026 (exactly 6 months back) and a claim dated 1 November 2025 do not. Two visits count as already used.
